name: Gurugram
description: Dinners, cafés, a mall at Navratri and a few pieces of art.

name: Bari
description: My hometown, in Dholpur district, Rajasthan.

name: Kasol
description: A village on the banks of the Parvati river in Kullu district, at about 1,580 m, and a base for treks to Malana and Kheerganga.

name: Manikaran
description: A pilgrimage town on the Parvati river, about 4 km from Kasol, known for hot springs at 64 to 80 °C and for its gurdwara and its Shiva and Rama temples.

name: Manali
description: A town in the Kullu valley on the Beas river, at the southern end of the Atal Tunnel and the starting point for the road north into Lahaul.

name: Sissu
description: A village in Lahaul on the Chandra river, at about 3,120 m, just north of the Atal Tunnel, with a lake and a waterfall of about 50 m across the river.

name: Jispa
description: A village in Lahaul on the Bhaga river, at about 3,200 m, 22 km north of Keylong and 7 km south of Darcha: a favourite overnight stop on the Manali–Leh highway.

name: Shinku La
description: A high pass at about 5,091 m on the border between Lahaul in Himachal Pradesh and Zanskar in Ladakh. The road up to it leaves the Manali–Leh highway near Darcha. It is snowbound from about October to April, and a tunnel under it has been under construction since 2024.

name: Ujjain
description: An old city on the Shipra river in Madhya Pradesh, one of India's seven sacred cities. It has the Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga, the Kaal Bhairav temple, Ram Ghat and the Siddhavat banyan, and the Simhastha Kumbh is held on the Shipra here every twelve years (the next is in 2028).

name: Omkareshwar
description: A temple town on Mandhata island in the Narmada river, in Khandwa district of Madhya Pradesh, with a Jyotirlinga temple. The island is said to be shaped like the sign Om. It is about 140 km from Ujjain by road (sources say 135 to 150 km).

name: Barwaha
description: A town on the Narmada in Khargone district of Madhya Pradesh, with ghats on the river, about 11 km from Omkareshwar in a straight line.
